supersedes: legacy cast v1.3 (historical; source path removed from working tree)
idPolicy: ids are data/event keys and never change; only presentation (species, art, assetKey) changed in v2

cast.silhouette: pear body + big round head + stubby wings + curled tail
cast.quirk: cannot breathe fire yet; sneezes star sparkles when delighted

cast.silhouette: stacked rectangle of linking cubes + screen head + antenna
cast.quirk: one cube always slightly crooked; clicks straight when the child solves it
cast.mathAffordance: can split into and rebuild from unit cubes (composition/decomposition)

cast.silhouette: small body + giant S-curved tail rising above head
cast.quirk: tail fluffs up when a pattern is found; lines up acorns in AB order
cast.mathAffordance: tail is a literal repeating AB pattern (stroke-dasharray 24/22)

cast.silhouette: small round ball + three-feather spring crest
cast.quirk: sings a three-note tune; sometimes perches on Aria's head

order: head(crest|horns|ears, skull, face(eyes, brows, mouth, cheeks))
layers.pivotRule: every animatable group carries style transform-origin in view-box px

requiredIdExceptions.reason: intentional: Qbo's screen shows the loading ring instead of eyes while thinking (decided P01, 2026-10-02)

layers.selectorPolicy: motion targets layers by class sh-<layer>; on-disk SVG keeps layer ids for Rive import; inline web markup drops layer ids and scopes gradient ids per instance (INSTANCE_UID_TOKEN)

acceptance: silhouette test: 4 black silhouettes identified by species >= 80% of 8-12 children aged 6-9
all 28 SVG (24 states + 4 busts) render without error in browser and cairo
no sharp teeth, claws, fire or angry brows in any state (Dana's rounded incisors: see toothPolicy)

toothPolicy.rule: no sharp teeth in any character
toothPolicy.exception: dana: two rounded, blunt front incisors (layer #teeth) are a squirrel species marker and are allowed; must stay rounded, never pointed
toothPolicy.reversible: remove the teeth layer in source/shomara-cast.mjs and rebuild if the child test or design lead rejects it
